name: Maison de M
source: You play as gay guy who is groundkeeper in a  apartmant building owned by his uncle. That apartmant building is reserverd only for gay man(more and less). The story is concentrated about love life of groundkeeper and his decision that interfere in other peoples lives.
translation: 你将扮演一名同性恋男子，在叔叔拥有的公寓楼里担任管理员。这栋公寓楼基本上只住同性恋男性。故事围绕管理员的恋爱生活，以及他干涉他人生活的决定展开。
